description: This file implements the CopyPasteManager class, which manages clipboard operations such as copying text to clipboard, retrieving and validating pasted text, and parsing operands for a calculator application. It includes regex patterns for different number formats and modes, and handles validation and sanitization of pasted expressions.

classes.name: CopyPasteManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing clipboard copy and paste operations, including validation and parsing of expressions for a calculator app.

methods.name: CopyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies a string to the system clipboard.

methods.name: GetStringToPaste
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and validates text from the clipboard based on the current mode and settings.

methods.name: HasStringToPaste
methods.description: Checks if there is text available in the clipboard.

methods.name: ValidatePasteExpression
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a pasted expression, ensuring it conforms to expected formats.

methods.name: ExtractOperands
methods.description: Extracts individual operands from a pasted expression based on the current mode.

methods.name: ExpressionRegExMatch
methods.description: Checks if operands match the regex patterns for the current mode and settings.

methods.name: GetMaxOperandLengthAndValue
methods.description: Calculates maximum length and value constraints for operands based on mode and settings.

methods.name: SanitizeOperand
methods.description: Removes unwanted characters from an operand string.

methods.name: TryOperandToULL
methods.description: Attempts to convert an operand string to an unsigned long long integer based on the number base.

methods.name: OperandLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of an operand considering mode-specific rules.

methods.name: StandardScientificOperandLength
methods.description: Calculates operand length for standard and scientific modes, accounting for decimal points and exponents.

methods.name: ProgrammerOperandLength
methods.description: Calculates operand length for programmer mode, considering prefixes, suffixes, and bit length.

methods.name: RemoveUnwantedCharsFromString
methods.description: Removes whitespace, punctuation, and currency symbols from a string.

methods.name: IsErrorMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message string indicates an error.
